verdict: 132 leads arrived this period; Google spend needs conversion tracking fixed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 132 leads at a cost of $21.30 per lead — all of them from Meta, which is carrying the full paid load on its own. Google Ads ran $1,504 in spend over the same window and recorded zero confirmed conversions, not because clicks stopped (194 came through) but because conversion tracking is being repaired and offline conversion import is being connected before month-end. Cost per lead rose 34% week-over-week, driven by a 31% spend increase that outpaced lead volume; Meta's day-level pattern shows a volatile but active signal rather than a true decline. With conversion visibility restored and dedicated landing pages launching by August 31, Google's spend will have a measurable path to credit leads properly next period.
